summary.text: Jim Dill is a Democratic member of the Maine House of Representatives for District 26 and is a candidate for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Dill, listed by Ballotpedia as James Dill, has represented District 26 since 2022 and previously served in the Maine Senate and House, and he is a former university professor.

paragraphs.text: Jim Dill lives in Old Town, Maine, and earned a B.S. and M.S. from the University of Maine and a Ph.D. in biology and entomology from Purdue University in 1979, according to Ballotpedia, which lists him as James Dill.
His career experience includes working as a university professor and a pest management specialist.
Dill represented Maine House District 14 from 2010 to 2014 and Maine State Senate District 5 from 2014 to 2022.
He won election to House District 26 in 2022 and again in 2024.

Ballotpedia lists his 2025-2026 committee assignment as the Elections Committee, and in 2021-2022 he chaired the Agriculture, Conservation and Forestry Committee and the Inland Fisheries and Wildlife Committee.
Adam Shaw, an Independent, is his 2026 general election opponent.
